query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registrations r WHERE r.email = u.email) as total_registrations,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registrations r WHERE r.email = u.email AND r.status = 'approved') as approved_registrations
FROM user u 
WHERE u.name LIKE '%FG%' OR u.name LIKE '%Felipe%'
LIMIT 5;
